synopsis: The US Air Force was the accepting body for Auto-GCAS [f1471]. Chapter 2 further identifies the Joint Program Office alongside the US Air Force as accepting Auto-GCAS evidence [f1919]. The glossary clarifies that this acceptance came from the US Air Force, not a civil regulator, distinguishing the precedent from civil regulatory acceptance [f15741]. The supplied facts give no acceptance date or detail on how responsibilities were divided between the two bodies [f1471, f15741, f1919].

relations.note: Both identify the US Air Force as the accepting body for Auto-GCAS.
Chapter 2 additionally names the Joint Program Office and specifies acceptance of evidence.
Adds the Joint Program Office as an evidence-accepting body alongside the Air Force.
